name: Marked by Rain
source:
Mizuki Takayanagi was absent from school for three days now. Without any meaningful contact with him or his family, Shoto Onodera takes it upon himself to go and investigate the reason for his club member’s strange disappearance. 

If only he wouldn't have such a bad feeling about what he could find at his house…

[From [url=https://iristoid.itch.io/marked-by-rain]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
高柳美月已经三天没有上学了。在与他或他的家人没有任何有意义的联系的情况下，小野寺翔人主动去调查他的俱乐部成员奇怪失踪的原因。

如果他不会因为自己在家里发现的东西而产生如此不好的预感就好了……

[来自[url=https://iristoid.itch.io/marked-by-rain]itch.io[/url]]
